name: e2e-volt-pos-webdriverio
description: Enterprise-grade WebdriverIO + tauri-driver E2E automation framework for the Volt POS desktop app (Tauri v2 / WebView2)

scripts.//lanes: Every `test:*` runs `preflight` first (drivers present, app resolved, no stale instance). ENV picks WHICH BINARY is driven - dev/staging/prod are three different .exe builds, not a runtime flag.
scripts.test:dev: npm run preflight && cross-env ENV=dev wdio run configs/wdio/wdio.dev.conf.ts
scripts.test:staging: npm run preflight && cross-env ENV=staging wdio run configs/wdio/wdio.staging.conf.ts
scripts.test:prod: npm run preflight && cross-env ENV=prod wdio run configs/wdio/wdio.prod.conf.ts
scripts.//suites: Tag-filtered lanes. @smoke is the only suite allowed to touch prod (read-only).
scripts.test:smoke: npm run preflight && cross-env ENV=dev wdio run configs/wdio/wdio.dev.conf.ts --suite smoke
scripts.test:regression: npm run preflight && cross-env ENV=dev wdio run configs/wdio/wdio.dev.conf.ts --suite regression
scripts.test:critical: npm run preflight && cross-env ENV=dev wdio run configs/wdio/wdio.dev.conf.ts --mochaOpts.grep @critical
scripts.test:spec: npm run preflight && cross-env ENV=dev wdio run configs/wdio/wdio.dev.conf.ts --spec
scripts.//all: EVERYTHING in one command: 18 unit cases (node:test) + all 227 E2E specs (smoke + regression + _recovery, via the default `tests/**/*.spec.ts` glob) = 245. `&` is cmd's sequential-unconditional operator, so the E2E lane still runs even if a unit case fails. The dashboard reflects only the 227 E2E — unit tests never feed it.
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit & npm run test:dev
scripts.//attach: ATTACH MODE - drives an ALREADY-RUNNING installed app over CDP instead of letting tauri-driver launch it. `app:launch` starts the app with WebView2 remote debugging on, then `test:attach` connects. This is the only mode that can drive a production install in place.
scripts.test:attach: cross-env ENV=dev WDIO_MODE=attach wdio run configs/wdio/wdio.attach.conf.ts
scripts.//web: WEB lane - drive the GoPOS web POS (pos.gocheckin.net) in Microsoft Edge, no app. `web:appointment` creates an appointment and writes .tmp/web-appointment-handoff.json for the app lane to verify. Creds in configs/env/.env.dev (WEB_*).
scripts.test:web-to-pos: npm run preflight && cross-env ENV=dev wdio run configs/wdio/wdio.dev.conf.ts --spec tests/regression/order-flow/web-to-pos-pending.spec.ts
scripts.//web2pos: FULL cross-surface check in one command: create an appointment on the GoPOS web POS, then launch Volt POS and confirm it synced. `&&` is sequential-conditional, so the app verify only runs if the web create succeeded.
scripts.test:web2pos: npm run web:appointment && npm run test:web-to-pos
scripts.//dashboard: React run dashboard (separate package in dashboard/). The DashboardReporter feeds it after every test lane; these just start/build the viewer.
scripts.//run+view: One command: run the WHOLE suite (DashboardReporter writes public/data/history.json at onComplete) then start the React viewer. cmd's `&` is sequential-unconditional, so the viewer opens even if some specs fail. Run `dashboard:install` once first. The viewer polls the JSON every 5s.
scripts.//fresh: Like test:dashboard but AWAITS the full test lane before opening the viewer, and prints clear progress markers so you can tell the run actually executed (not just the stale history being shown). Use this when test:dashboard seems to only show old results.
scripts.//unit: Pure-function tests for src/domain — no app, no driver. node:test via tsx, so no extra dependency. Runs in ~1s and gates a commit.
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:unit
